classification: negative result for one fixed compressed-text interpretation
hypothesis: Global count-first no-repeat enumerative rank plus page-concatenated word-boundary combinadic rank forms a fixed-length big-endian zlib/DEFLATE stream.
rank_order: colex rank of the 86 repeat-position mask
boundary_carrier: Page-local combinadic colex ranks of printed word-boundary gaps, concatenated in page order as a mixed-radix integer.
test: Node zlib.inflateSync on fixed-length big-endian bytes of the combined integer.

validation.meaning: The SFT asserts zlib validity must be false; successful run means the candidate was rejected as a zlib stream.

scope_limit: Rejects only this count-first/page-concatenated-boundary/zlib mapping. It does not reject other compression models, rank orders selected by new source evidence, or authentic keys.
